filesystem_readiness.mode: isolated temporary root, verified ontology and store health

assets.mode: production bundle with local immutable assets

limitations.detail: The production graph-authority adapter remains deliberately unconfigured and is qualified only for its fail-closed unavailable result; live named-human grants require a later selected adapter and fresh real-adapter qualification.
limitations.reopens_on: selection or configuration of a production graph-authority adapter

limitations.detail: Capacity and fault thresholds qualify one local Linux node and bounded synthetic concurrency; distributed sustained-load and deployment observation remain Milestone G scope.
limitations.reopens_on: topology, capacity profile, runtime, store, proxy, or deployment change

reopening_conditions: a real adapter, dependency, lockfile, build, browser, proxy, TLS, OS, fixture, query, schema, or ontology identity drifts
any declared latency, memory, row, byte, cache, concurrency, timeout, or resource threshold is exceeded
an outage, timeout, lag, restart, stale, revocation, skew, malformed-content, or maintenance path exposes old data or reports false readiness

protected responses become cacheable or leak identity, authority, scope, IRI, secret, content, query, or cross-scope diagnostics through HTML, headers, referrers, logs, telemetry, caches, or browser storage
the unconfigured production graph-authority posture is described as a live grant adapter
a limitation, owner, expiry, result, command, threshold, or reopening condition is removed or weakened
